entities.summary: Robert B. "Robbie" Nichols was a professional American football linebacker in the National Football League. He attended the University of Tulsa. He competed in football and track for Tulsa. He would play with the Baltimore Colts in 1970 and 1971, and was a member of the Colts' Super Bowl V winning team.
